_meta.purpose: A PALETTE of orthogonal diversity facets the Construct stage samples from. These are INSPIRATION to vary scenarios across — NOT a checklist to exhaust, NOT the primary driver. Lens-reasoning + verbatim reference grounding remain primary. Per the user: any one facet (e.g. builder defaults) is just one facet — do not rely on it alone.
_meta.authored_from: internal expert knowledge; complemented by gathered builder-corpus (_seeds/bySc) and deep-research methods
_meta.usage: For each aspect, draw a SMALL varied combination (e.g. 1 domain + 1 component + 1 mechanism family), and let several pages cross different facet combinations (combinatorial). Most pages must still require human semantic/contextual/visual judgment.

componentPatterns.source: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG) patterns — each ships signature failures

ariaAntiPatterns.source: "No ARIA is better than bad ARIA" (APG) + common audit findings
items: aria-label overrides/contradicts the visible text label
aria-labelledby points to an empty or wrong/hidden element
redundant or wrong role (role=button on a real <button>, role=text, role=presentation on meaningful content)
aria-hidden="true" on a focusable or interactive element
div/span with onclick acting as a button but no role/name/keyboard
icon-font or SVG glyph as the only label (no text alternative)
placeholder used as the only label (disappears on input)
title attribute as the only accessible name (not reliably exposed)
aria-live region present but politeness/atomic wrong, or content swapped without it
visually-correct order but DOM/tab order scrambled by CSS (flex/grid order, float, absolute)
state conveyed only visually (aria-expanded/checked/selected never updated)
decorative image with meaningful alt, or meaningful image with empty alt
heading level chosen for visual size, not document structure

visualOnlyConveyance: color alone signals state/category (required field red, error red, status dot)
position/proximity alone groups label with control
icon shape alone conveys meaning (✓/✗, arrows, trash)
font-weight/size alone implies heading or emphasis
CSS ::before/::after content carries the only text
underline/no-underline alone distinguishes links from text
contentAuthoringSources: pasted from Microsoft Word (mso styles, fake bold headings, empty paragraphs)
pasted from Google Docs (span soup, inline styles)
rich-text editor output (TinyMCE/CKEditor/Quill — div wrappers, <b>/<i> not <strong>/<em>)
PDF-to-HTML conversion (absolutely-positioned spans, reading order lost)
markdown renderer (auto heading IDs, no landmarks)
HTML email newsletter (layout tables, inline styles, spacer images)
CMS WYSIWYG demo/placeholder content left in production
dynamicStatePatterns: SPA client-side route change without updating document.title or moving focus
infinite scroll / lazy-load appending content silently
async form validation updating errors without announcing them
toast/snackbar notification outside any live region
skeleton/loading placeholders with no status announcement
optimistic UI / autosave with silent state change
multi-step wizard where progress/step is visual-only
real-time updates (price, chat, stock) not announced
expand/collapse that moves focus unexpectedly or not at all
i18nContexts: CJK content with Latin-only lang attribute
translated UI where title/label not translated (mixed language)
lang attribute missing or wrong on a passage in another language
locale-specific date/number/currency formats in error messages
atBehaviors: screen magnifier (focus must be visible & reflow at 200-400% zoom)
voice control (Dragon/Voice Control — spoken label must match accessible name)
switch access / keyboard-only (every action reachable & operable)
braille display (terse output; relies on programmatic name/role)
Windows High Contrast / forced-colors mode (color-only cues vanish)
